public_rationale: The evidence supports Marcus's narrower point that a shared internal mechanism was not established. The author's thread also reports meaningful correspondences and model manipulations, so it does support an empirical link. Calling that a 'direct link' need not assert identical mechanisms. The outcome therefore depends on the contextual mechanistic reading.
limitations: This does not establish that shared mechanisms are absent.
A literal denial of any empirical link would not be supported.
The cited thread is the researcher's own summary, reproduced by a third party.
